name: Zombie Society Dead Detective: Back From The Dead
summary:
After a whole seven years, another entry in the “Zombie Society - Dead Detective” series. Zombies took over the planet and their victory was absolute. But zombie society still has its problems, with rampant crime topping the list.
Take on the role of undead private detective Margh and solve the mystery at hand with the help of his willing but unwieldy assistant, Ghvnn, in this humorous graphic adventure that combines point-and-click mechanics with an elaborate “deaduction” system.
Visit the crime scene, interrogate decomposing suspects and quirky witnesses, gather clues and use your brain (or what's left of it) to interpret them and arrive at the case's conclusion - hopefully the right one.
